title: Site-wide logo replacement with new image URL

requirements.summary: Replace all TrustFix logo instances across the site with https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png while preserving existing layout, spacing, and proportions
acceptanceCriteria: The Navbar header displays only https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png as the logo.
The HeroSection displays only https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png as the logo.
No white-box logo, old shield icon, or any previous logo image URL appears anywhere on the page.
All old logo src references are removed from the codebase.
Logo proportions and alignment in each section match the existing layout — no stretching or distortion.
No changes to layout, spacing, colors, fonts, or header height are introduced.

file_operations.description: Replace the existing logo image source in the Navbar component with https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png. Remove any old logo references (including any shield icons or white-box logos). Preserve the existing img element's className, width, height, and all other attributes to maintain current sizing and alignment. Do not modify the header height, spacing, or layout.

Replace the existing logo image source in the HeroSection component with https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png. Remove any old logo references. Preserve the existing img element's className, width, height, and all styling attributes to maintain current proportions and alignment within the hero banner. Do not modify the section layout, overlay, or spacing.

If the Footer component contains any logo image, replace its source with https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png and remove old logo references. Preserve existing sizing and styling. If no logo exists in the Footer, skip this operation.
